head: Koivunen wins it in overtime
paras: Steven Stamkos got the scoring started for the Predators midway through the first, but Connor Dewar made it 1-1 for Pittsburgh just 18 seconds into the second. Jayden Struble scored his first goal for Nashville early in the second to put the Predators ahead 2-1. With the goalie pulled and just over a minute left, Rickard Rakell tied it 2-2 for Pittsburgh. Ville Koivunen won it in overtime.

The Penguins carried the play, outshooting the Predators 37-26, but needed overtime to win it. Artūrs Šilovs made 24 saves for the Pens, and Juuse Saros stopped 34 of 37. Nobody on the ice had a bigger night than Elmer Söderblom, even with Koivunen’s overtime winner in the game, by our Swing measure.

Only two penalties were called all night, something the league sees about once every 20 games. The Penguins improved to 5-6-1, sixth in the Metropolitan. The Predators fell to 3-3-4, seventh in the Central.

items.text: Steven Stamkos scored again against Pittsburgh, and has six goals in eight games against them since 2023-24.
Reid Schaefer was in NHL.com’s projected lineup, but Vitali Pinchuk played instead.
One of the preview’s two calls held.
